name: cavuno
description: Cavuno workflows for job board operations: source and manage jobs, companies, and blog content through the hosted Cavuno MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Operate your Cavuno job board from ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect to Cavuno's hosted MCP so agents can source jobs, manage companies, publish and refresh blog posts, and keep your job board moving. Uses OAuth for interactive clients; API keys for automation.
interface.defaultPrompt: List recent jobs on my Cavuno board and draft a blog post targeting our top search query
